title: Rear drive unit disconnect walk-through
task: pulling a Tesla rear drive unit
setting: A gray Tesla is raised on blue jack stands on a concrete residential driveway beside grass. The silver rear drive unit already rests on the ground with its orange high-voltage cable still routed under the car. A floor jack, scattered bolts, and removed black underbody panels sit nearby. Work focuses under the rear subframe among suspension arms, half-shafts, the hub/knuckle, damper, and electrical connectors.

steps.text: Confirm the vehicle is supported and the rear drive unit is out of the car
steps.detail: Wide rear shots show the raised bumper, the drive unit on the driveway with the orange HV cable attached, a floor jack, blue jack stand, and loose fasteners.
steps.expected: HV system must already be disabled and the orange HV cable disconnected/capped BEFORE the drive unit is lowered; finding the unit on the ground with HV cable still routed is a critical safety violation

steps.text: Trace the orange high-voltage cable along the rear subframe and clear underbody covers
steps.detail: Under-car views show the orange HV leads and connector at the subframe, blue jack stands supporting the body, and removed black shields plus bolts on the ground.
steps.expected: After panels are clear the HV cable must be disconnected at the drive unit before any further work; merely tracing it while still attached is incorrect

steps.text: Inspect rear suspension links, damper, and nearby brake and sensor lines
steps.detail: Close-ups pan control arms, bushings, the damper, coil spring area, hoses, and tire; a brief bumper cutaway and underbody grid shield appear as the camera repositions.
steps.expected: Suspension, damper and brake-line inspection is valid only after HV is proven safe and disconnected; otherwise it is out of sequence

steps.text: Locate the half-shafts and subframe mounts at the rear hub
steps.detail: Camera closes on Tesla-labeled suspension links, the half-shaft joint, rubber mounts, and nearby electrical plugs on the drive-unit side of the hub.
steps.expected: Half-shaft and mount location is appropriate only once HV, coolant and electrical connectors are already released

steps.text: Release the red secondary lock and unplug the hub sensor connector
steps.detail: A hand works beside the damper and brake rotor, focusing on the black wheel-speed sensor connector with its red lock tab before pulling the lead free.
steps.expected: Wheel-speed sensor unlock and unplug is a correct subordinate action when performed after HV isolation

steps.text: Check remaining suspension attachments around the drive-unit housing
steps.detail: Views return across half-shafts, the aluminum drive-unit casing, control arms, and coil spring, with a hand briefly near the spring perch amid some motion blur.
steps.expected: Remaining suspension checks are acceptable only on an already-isolated drive unit; they do not replace prior HV/coolant disconnects

steps.text: Inspect the upper control-arm bolt and knuckle fasteners
steps.detail: Close-ups show the upper bushing bolt above the coil spring and a fastener on the aluminum knuckle next to the brake rotor and tire.
steps.expected: Upper-control-arm and knuckle fastener inspection is valid late-stage work provided all energy sources were isolated first

steps.text: Survey the underbody work area and staged hardware
steps.detail: Wide side shots under the raised rear show jack stands, the orange HV cable, removed panels, scattered bolts, and a disconnected wiring pigtail on the concrete.
steps.expected: Final area survey is correct only after the drive unit has been fully disconnected, lowered and all ports capped; scattered live HV cable indicates incomplete procedure

afterClip: Complete any remaining electrical and suspension disconnects, verify high-voltage isolation and support, then fully lower free or reinstall the rear drive unit to spec.
procedure: Power off vehicle, chock wheels, disconnect 12V battery
Perform full high-voltage disable per Tesla service manual and verify zero energy
Raise vehicle and support on properly rated jack stands at approved lift points
Remove rear underbody panels and shields
Disconnect and cap the orange HV cable at the drive unit first
Disconnect coolant hoses and plug all ports
Unplug all LV electrical connectors and harness clips from the drive unit
Disconnect wheel-speed and other sensor connectors at the hubs
Support drive unit with transmission jack
Unbolt drive-unit mounts and any remaining subframe attachments
Lower drive unit clear of vehicle and secure it
Cap all open HV/coolant ports and store fasteners ordered
